title: backend-skeleton runtime contract-conformance report
description: The persisted, committed aggregate `bskel observe import` writes to specs/<feature_id>/observe/<feature_id>.conformance-report.json, summarizing a stream of observe-receipt.schema.json lines. Backs the `conformance` gate (lib/gate-definitions.mjs). Evidence-first: passing the gate means the import was structurally valid, not that zero violations were found -- see violation_count. See DECISIONS.md D-runtime-conformance-receipts.

noise_lines.description: lines in --receipts that were not valid JSON at all -- counted and warned about, not fatal (a log pipeline realistically is not perfectly scoped to just this logger).

matched.description: receipts whose contract_ref equals the CURRENT contract hash -- these count as evidence for the current contract.

stale_contract_ref.description: receipts recorded against a contract_ref that no longer matches -- kept on record for audit/trend purposes, not counted as current evidence.
